segments.name: U.S. pawn
segments.evidence: The U.S. pawn segment consists of pawn operations in 29 U.S. states and the District of Columbia

segments.name: Latin America pawn
segments.description: Operates larger format, full-service pawn stores in Mexico, Guatemala, El Salvador and Colombia serving unbanked and under-banked customers.
segments.evidence: The Latin America pawn segment consists of pawn operations in Mexico, Guatemala, El Salvador and Colombia

segments.name: U.K. pawn
segments.description: Operates pawn stores in England, Scotland and Wales, focusing primarily on loans collateralized by gold jewelry.
segments.evidence: The U.K. pawn segment consists of pawn operations in England, Scotland and Wales

segments.name: retail POS payment solutions
segments.description: Operates American First Finance, offering lease-to-own and retail financing payment solutions to U.S. merchant partners and their customers.
segments.evidence: The retail POS payment solutions segment consists of the operations of American First Finance, LLC ("AFF"), which offers products in the U.S.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay pawn service fees on non-recourse pawn loans and pay retail prices for merchandise, while merchant partners and consumers pay for AFF's lease-to-own and retail finance solutions.
revenueModel.evidence: AFF's retail partners provide consumer goods and services to their customers and use AFF's LTO and retail finance solutions to facilitate payments on such transactions.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company acquired H&T, the leading pawn operator in the United Kingdom, adding a new U.K. pawn segment.
changes.evidence: The Company completed the acquisition of H&T, the leading pawn operator in the United Kingdom with 286 store locations, on August 14, 2025, the date which the balance sheet and operating results of H&T were included in the Company's consolidated financial results.
